mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS accountId, i.codef_org_code AS bankCode, i.name AS bankName, a.account_type AS accountType, a.account_name AS accountName, a.account_no_masked AS accountNoMasked, a.currency AS currency, (SELECT bs.balance FROM mock_codef_balance_snapshot bs WHERE bs.account_id = a.id ORDER BY bs.snapshot_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS balance, DATE_FORMAT(c.last_synced_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+09:00') AS lastSyncAt FROM mock_codef_account a JOIN mock_codef_connection c ON c.id = a.connection_id JOIN mock_codef_institution i ON i.id = c.institution_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND a.account_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND i.is_supported = 1 ORDER BY a.id

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.account_name AS accountName, i.name AS institutionName, a.currency AS currency, DATE_FORMAT(c.last_synced_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+09:00') AS lastSyncAt FROM mock_codef_account a JOIN mock_codef_connection c ON c.id = a.connection_id JOIN mock_codef_institution i ON i.id = c.institution_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND a.account_type = 'STOCK' AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND i.is_supported = 1 ORDER BY a.id LIMIT 1

SELECT stock_code AS stockCode, stock_name AS stockName, market_country AS marketCountry, currency AS currency, quantity AS quantity, average_purchase_price AS averagePurchasePrice, last_price AS lastPrice, purchase_amount AS purchaseAmount, market_value AS marketValue, profit_loss_amount AS profitLossAmount, profit_loss_rate AS profitLossRate FROM mock_codef_stock_holding WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY id

SELECT l.id AS loanId, i.name AS bankName, l.loan_name AS loanName, l.loan_type AS loanType, l.currency AS currency, l.loan_amount AS loanAmount, l.balance AS balance, l.interest_rate AS interestRate, DATE_FORMAT(l.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(l.maturity_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS maturityDate, l.monthly_payment AS monthlyPayment, DATE_FORMAT(l.next_payment_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS nextPaymentDate FROM mock_codef_loan l JOIN mock_codef_account a ON a.id = l.account_id JOIN mock_codef_connection c ON c.id = a.connection_id JOIN mock_codef_institution i ON i.id = c.institution_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND i.is_supported = 1 ORDER BY l.id

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(c.last_synced_at), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+09:00') FROM mock_codef_loan l JOIN mock_codef_account a ON a.id = l.account_id JOIN mock_codef_connection c ON c.id = a.connection_id JOIN mock_codef_institution i ON i.id = c.institution_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND i.is_supported = 1

SELECT p.id AS payMoneyId, p.provider_code AS providerCode, p.provider_name AS providerName, i.name AS institutionName, p.wallet_name AS walletName, p.currency AS currency, p.balance AS balance, p.available_amount AS availableAmount, p.point_amount AS pointAmount, DATE_FORMAT(p.last_synced_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+09:00') AS lastSyncAt FROM mock_codef_pay_money p JOIN mock_codef_account a ON a.id = p.account_id JOIN mock_codef_connection c ON c.id = a.connection_id JOIN mock_codef_institution i ON i.id = c.institution_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND i.is_supported = 1 ORDER BY p.id

SELECT a.id FROM mock_codef_account a JOIN mock_codef_connection c ON c.id = a.connection_id JOIN mock_codef_institution i ON i.id = c.institution_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND a.account_no_masked = #{accountNoMasked} AND i.is_supported = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id FROM mock_codef_account a JOIN mock_codef_connection c ON c.id = a.connection_id JOIN mock_codef_institution i ON i.id = c.institution_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND a.account_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND i.is_supported = 1 ORDER BY a.id LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id AS accountId, i.name AS institutionName, bs.balance AS balance, bs.available_amount AS availableAmount, bs.valuation_amount AS valuationAmount, a.currency AS currency, DATE_FORMAT(bs.snapshot_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+09:00') AS snapshotAt FROM mock_codef_account a JOIN mock_codef_connection c ON c.id = a.connection_id JOIN mock_codef_institution i ON i.id = c.institution_id LEFT JOIN mock_codef_balance_snapshot bs ON bs.account_id = a.id WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND i.is_supported = 1 ORDER BY bs.snapshot_at DESC LIMIT 1
